name: National Liberation Front of South Vietnam (Viet Cong)
description: A field divided horizontally red over light blue with a yellow five-pointed star at the centre.
history: Flag of the NLF (Viet Cong) from 1960 and of the Provisional Revolutionary Government of South Vietnam 1969–1976, when the country was unified under Hanoi's flag.

features.symbolism: the North's red and star over the blue of the 'peace-loving South'
